articles.title_zh: 空间和组成控制下的多式联运 与Latent扩散的MRI合成
articles.content_zh: 细胞瘤在肿瘤形态学和各种核磁共振模式的构成中表现出显著的异质性,往往使临床数据集在患者病理方面极不平衡。 我们提出一个两阶段潜在扩散模型(LDM)框架,用于生成可明确控制的2D glioblastoma磁共振扫描. 首先,分块LDM生成以位置、空间范围、轴位置和次区域构成为条件的肿瘤图。 第二,一个带有ControlNet的有模式条件的LDM生成T1,T1Gd,T2,以及FLAIR图像,坚持要求的分区. 在被搁置的测试集中,生成的片段实现了0.842像素的平均百分数误差和0.795个百分点的次区域比例误差. ControlNet改进了Fréchet在所有四种模式中的启动距离(FID),将集合的FID从42.59减少到36.12。 专家读者研究得出的平均质量评级为:真实图像6.60,控制网生成的图像6.83,全面合成图像6.77。

articles.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
articles.content: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. EmoReward first plans specific grounding cues from the emotional prompt to guide evaluation, then uses heterogeneous signal primitives to score the generated video during the act stage. Reflective Reward Gating calibrates their contributions through instance-level gates for phase, face confidence, conflict, and subtlety, then renormalizes weights over the active set to produce the sample's fused reward. RewardMemory then estimates each primitive's reliability from rollout scores and outcomes within each emotional regime in the finished training run, then fixes bounded multipliers that calibrate fusion weights in the next training run without updating reward models. Experiments on HunyuanVideo 1.5 show improvements across multiple RL algorithms and compare EmoReward with other agentic reward methods under SAGE-GRPO. Ablations and transfer experiments on SD 3.5 and FLUX further support adaptive reward calibration for visual generation.

articles.title_zh: EmoReward:情感视频生成RL的自我演化Reward校准
articles.content_zh: 群相对政策优化(GRPO)在代码和数学等可核查领域拥有先进的基因模型后培训,但评价视频质量,尤其是情感表达,往往依赖于主观美学,没有独特的正确目标. 现有方法通常依赖于视觉质量、运动质量和文本对齐的固定奖赏,这些奖赏捕捉不到情感意图,并可能招致奖励性黑客,而RLHF则难以衡量规模,并受到个人审美差异的影响,使面部、身体运动和不同叙事背景的色调的校准复杂化。 我们引入了EmoReward,一种新的自我演变的培训机制,它从实际培训期间收集的奖励痕迹中提取出证据的可靠性,通过确定哪些情感证据可以信任,以及有多少重量来适应性地指导后续培训中的多重奖励权重分配. EmoReward首先计划从情感的提示来引导评价,然后在动作阶段使用各种信号原始来评分生成的视频. 反射奖赏 校准他们的贡献 通过实例级的关卡 相, 面对信心,冲突,和微妙, 然后重新正常 重过活动集 产生样本的保险赏金。 然后,Reward Memory从完成的训练中每个情感制度内部的推出分数和结果来估计每个原始人的可靠性,然后在下次训练中修正校准聚变重量的极限乘数,而不更新奖励模型. HunyuanVideo 1.5上的实验显示多个RL算法都有改进,并将EmoReward与其他代理奖励方法在SAGE-GPRO下进行比较. SD 3.5和FLUX上的校准和转移实验进一步支持了视觉生成的适应性奖励校准.

articles.title: Object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers: architecture, representation, and acquisition shortcuts
articles.content: Reported performance in small astronomical image datasets can reflect object reuse, field-of-view differences, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived properties as well as astronomical morphology. We designed \dataset{} to measure these effects in a four-class task comprising galaxies, globular clusters, nebulae, and open clusters. The dataset contains 370 catalogue-supported physical objects, each represented by three Digitised Sky Survey FITS bands, and uses a group-constrained split of 222 training, 75 validation, and 73 test objects. We compared a custom CNN--Transformer trained from scratch with ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 under an adaptive full-field representation, a common angular field, and two central-region-masked controls, using three fixed seeds. In the one-pass object-independent test, mean balanced accuracy on the adaptive view was $0.773\pm0.014$, $0.874\pm0.054$, and $0.866\pm0.023$ for the custom model, ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16, respectively. No primary architecture contrast rejected its null after Holm correction; ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 differed by 0.007 balanced-accuracy points (95\% cluster-bootstrap interval $[-0.048,0.062]$). Controls based on acquisition and catalogue metadata reached 0.721--0.735, and central-region-masked adaptive views reached 0.731--0.800. These results demonstrate generalisation to unseen physical objects, but also show that image context, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived object properties carry substantial class information. In this regime, high accuracy cannot be interpreted as evidence that a classifier learned target morphology, and the comparison does not isolate architecture from pretraining.

articles.title_zh: 对小数据天文图像分类器的天体独立评价:架构、表示和获取快捷键
articles.content_zh: 在小型天文图像数据集中报告的表现可以反映物体的再利用、视野差异、获取设置、目录衍生的特性以及天文形态。 我们设计了\datasetQQ 来测量这些效应 在一个四级的任务中, 包括星系,球状星团,星云,和开放星团。 该数据集包含370个目录支持的物理物体,每个物体由3个Digitised Sky Survey FITS波段代表,并使用一组受约束的分成222个训练,75个验证,73个测试物体. 我们把自始至终训练的CNN-Transformer与ImageNet- pretrained ResNet-50和Vit-B/16在适应性的全场代表、共同角场和两个中部区域大规模控制下进行比较,使用三个固定种子。 在单通过对象独立测试中,适应视图上的平均平衡精度分别为0.773\pm0.014美元,0.874\pm0.054美元,定制模型ResNet-50和Vit-B/16分别为0.866\pm0.023美元. 在Holm更正后,没有任何主结构的对比否定其无效;ResNet-50和Vit-B/16的平衡精确点差0.007(95+Q群-bootstrap间隔 $[0.048,0.062]美元)。 基于获取和目录元数据的控制达到0.721-0.735,中部地区大规模适应观点达到0.731-0.800. 这些结果显示了对看不见的物理物体的概括,但也表明图像上下文、获取设置和目录衍生物体属性载有大量类信息。 在这个制度下,高精度不能被解释为一个分类者学会的目标形态学的证据,而比较并不能将建筑与预训隔离开来.

articles.title: A 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and segmentation
articles.content: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.

articles.title_zh: 三维基础模型,统一CT解释和分割
articles.content_zh: 放射学家通过共同确定一项发现在三维(3D)解剖学中代表什么和位于何处,来解释计算成的地形图扫描. 然而,CT模型将CT解释和3D分割作为单独的任务处理,使得文字结论在空间上无法验证,并忽略了临床理解和空间感知之间的潜在协同作用. 在此,我们介绍HoloCT,一个通用的3D基础模型,通过联合建模整卷上下文和精细的解剖细节,将CT解释和voxel级分解统一起来,提供3D口罩作为证据. 我们负责HoloDATA, 包括来自73个公共数据集和6个临床组群的195,921个CT扫描,有620万个指令对话,280万个CT-mask对. 在整个346项任务中,包括分解、病变筛查、视觉问题回答和61个内部数据集和12个外部数据集的报告生成,HoloCT的绩效超过了专家和基础模型。 在多中心验证5家医院的11 455个临床CT扫描中,HoloCT在损伤分解和报告生成中的表现超过竞争模型的18.2和15.3分. 它还在甲状腺肿瘤和结肠损伤筛查中实现了85.1%的精确度,超过了参加回溯性阅读器研究的四名放射学家。 进一步的分析揭示了双向语义-空间协同:语言指导分解在不见踪影的解剖结构和损伤以及散开的自由文字发现,比领先方法高22.1分,同时促使模型在文字输出的同时产生相应的3D口罩,大大改善了口译性能。 HoloCT显示,临床理解和空间感知可以在一个单一的基础模型中共同学习,并提供一个更准确可靠的CT分析路径.

articles.title: CoDecide: Content-Adaptive Video Decoding for High-Throughput Video Analytics
articles.content: Analytics on video archives are bottlenecked by decoding. In a dense pipeline that runs a detector on every frame, decoding is a small fraction of the runtime, but once the detector is restricted to selected frames, decoding takes over as the main cost. We introduce CoDecide, a retrospective analytics system that only decodes the frames where new content appears, using signals from the compressed bitstream to find them. Motion tells us something is moving, but not whether it is new to the scene or has been there the whole time. To make that distinction, we supervise a lightweight compressed-domain student on a label-free novelty signal from a frozen DINOv2 teacher, which fires on semantically new regions rather than on any motion. Consequently, the student model generalizes to new camera deployments without requiring per-camera retraining. At inference, it decides which frames to decode and which regions to reconstruct. Detections from the decoded frames are propagated to the skipped frames using motion vectors. We evaluate CoDecide with a leave-one-dataset-out protocol on VIRAT, MEVA, and ShanghaiTech. Against a dense per-frame detector, CoDecide recovers more moving-object detections than prior compressed-domain selectors at an equivalent decoding budget, outperforming even a competitor trained directly on the target camera. CoDecide runs 15 to 24x faster than a pipeline that decodes and detects every frame. Code is available at https://github.com/shristy51/CoDecide.

articles.title_zh: 缩写 : 高压视频解码 视频分析
articles.content_zh: 视频档案的分析因解码而瓶颈. 在一个在每个帧上运行一个探测器的密集管道中,解码是运行时间的一小部分,但一旦探测器被限制在选定的帧上,解码就承担了主要成本. 我们引入了CoDecide,一种回顾分析系统,它只解码出现新内容的帧,使用压缩位流的信号来找到它们. 动议告诉我们,有些东西在动, 但并不是它是新到现场还是一直在那里。 为了做出这种区分,我们监督一个轻量级压缩域的学生, 在一个无标签的新颖信号上,来自一个被冻结的DINov2教师, 发射的星系新区域而不是任何运动。 因此,学生模式一般采用新的摄像机布置,不需要每台摄像机再培训。 推论,它决定了哪些框架可以解码,哪些区域可以重建. 使用运动向量将解码框架的检测结果传播到跳过的框架。 我们评价CoDecide 和VIRAT、MEVA和上海Tech 的一数据设置协议。 针对密集的每帧探测器,CoDecide在等效的解码预算中比之前的压缩域选择器回收更多的移动对象探测器,甚至比直接在目标相机上训练的竞争者都表现优异. CoDecide运行的15至24x比一个能解码和检测每个帧的管道快. 代码见https://github.com/shristy51/CoDecide。

articles.title: Beyond Infraction Scores: Failure-Boundary Profiles for Closed-Loop Evaluation of Driving and Robot Navigation Agents
articles.content: Closed-loop driving benchmarks in CARLA rank agents by a driving score that multiplies route completion by an infraction penalty. This score does not distinguish an agent that stops in front of an obstacle from one that pushes past it. In a corridor closed by two parked cars, for example, one agent that drives through with contact averages 52.2 on the blocked widths, while the agents that stop average between 37.8 and 40.6. We propose failure-boundary profiles, an evaluation in which each scenario family varies one measured factor, such as corridor width or the time gap in oncoming traffic, and each variant is certified from measurement as one where the agent should proceed or one where it should stop. Along this axis we estimate two curves per agent, commitment (the probability of attempting the passage) and competence (the probability of passing without contact), and locate where each crosses one half, with intervals that account for the simulator's run-to-run variance. The certified labels also give a summary metric, decision accuracy, which credits clean passes on passable variants and stops on blocked ones. We evaluate seven driving agents on seven CARLA families. The rule-based expert reaches a decision accuracy of 0.74 and TFv6, the highest-scoring learned agent, 0.60. Agents with similar driving scores fail in different ways, and agents that reliably stop at a blocked corridor still rarely wait for a gap in oncoming traffic. We also apply the method, unchanged, to a warehouse robot in Isaac Sim. The navigation policy we test stops at blocked gaps in only one of three families, and two fine-tuned versions of it pass more gaps cleanly but no longer stop at all.

articles.title_zh: 超越违法行为 分数:对驾驶和机器人导航代理机进行闭环评价的失败边界简介
articles.content_zh: CARLA的闭路驾驶基准通过一个驾驶分数将完成路线乘以违纪处罚来给特工排队. 此分数并不区分在障碍前停留的代理人和推过障碍的代理人. 例如,在一个被两辆停靠的汽车封闭的走廊中,一个有接触者驾驶的特工在被阻断的宽度上平均为52.2,而平均停在37.8至40.6之间的特工. 我们提出失败边界简介,即一个评估,其中每个情况家族都不同一个衡量因素,如走廊宽度或到达流量的时空,每个变体从测量中被证明是代理人应该继续工作或停止工作。 沿着这个轴线,我们估计每个代理商的两个曲线,承诺(尝试通过的可能性)和胜任能力(没有接触的通过概率),并找出每个代理商跨越一半的地方,其间隔是计算模拟器运行中的差异的. 经认证的标签还给出了一个简要的衡量标准,决定准确度,将可通行的变体记为干净的,并停在被屏蔽的变体上。 我们评价了7个CARLA家庭的7个司机。 基于规则的专家达到了0.74和TFv6的判定精度,是得分最高的学习剂,0.60. 驾驶分数相似的特工以不同的方式失败,可靠地停在被封锁的走廊的特工仍然很少等待即将到来的交通缺口. 我们还对Isaac Sim的一个仓库机器人适用了这个方法,没有改变。 我们测试的导航政策只停留在三个家庭中的一个被堵住的缺口上,两个经过微调的版本更清晰地传递了更多的缺口,但再也不会停止.

articles.title: Within-Family EfficientNet Scaling under Fixed-Resolution Transfer Learning for Spectral-Domain Optical Coherence Tomography Retinal Disease Classification
articles.content: Background/Objectives: CNNs perform well in retinal disease classification from spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT), but whether EfficientNet's natural-image scaling hierarchy transfers to medical-image transfer learning at fixed resolution remains unclear. This study evaluates EfficientNet-B0-B7 for four-class SD-OCT classification and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Methods: Eight ImageNet-pretrained variants (4.05-64.10M instantiated backbone parameters) were evaluated at 224x224 on the Kermany dataset. Grayscale images were replicated to RGB and processed using model-embedded preprocessing and augmentation. Training comprised frozen-backbone head training followed by partial fine-tuning. Metrics covered classification, discrimination, efficiency, and visual analyses. Results: Test accuracy varied non-monotonically from 95.93% (B0) to 96.95% (B1); B7 achieved 96.73%. B1 had the highest accuracy and Drusen F1 (0.8780), while B7 had Drusen F1 of 0.8720 and the highest Drusen recall (0.9177). Drusen had the lowest F1 across all variants and contributed 82.2% of the summed squared deviation in class-specific F1; class ranking remained Normal > CNV > DME > Drusen. The OCT accuracy ranking differed from the reported ImageNet hierarchy, where B7 ranked first. The accuracy-to-parameter ratio fell from 19.82 to 1.48 percentage points per million total parameters. The final train-test gap had a weak, non-significant association with test accuracy (r = 0.26, p = 0.53). Conclusions: Larger EfficientNet variants did not consistently improve SD-OCT classification. B1 achieved the highest accuracy and Drusen F1, whereas B7 showed a secondary accuracy recovery at greater model size and CPU latency, indicating task and protocol dependent scaling effects. As cross-partition duplicates have not been independently audited, results are conditional on the supplied split.

articles.title_zh: 家庭内部高效 在光谱-领域光学一致性的固定分辨率转移学习下的净扩展
articles.content_zh: 背景/目标: CNN在从光谱域光学一致性图谱学(SD-OCT)进行视网膜疾病分类方面表现良好,但OfficialNet的自然成像分级转移到医学成像转移学习的固定分辨率是否仍然不清楚. 本研究评价了四类SD-OCT分类的高效Net-B0-B7和精度效率的权衡. 方法:在Kermany数据集上以224x224评价了8个ImageNet前置变体(4.05-64.10M即时主干参数). 灰度图像被复制到RGB,并使用模型嵌入的预处理和增强处理. 培训包括冷冻后骨头培训,然后进行部分微调。 计量包括分类、歧视、效率和视觉分析。 结果: 测试精度从95.93%(B0)到96.95%(B1)不等;B7达到96.73%。 B1的精确度最高,Drusen F1(0.8780),而B7的Drusen F1为0.8720,最高的Drusen召回(0.9177). 德鲁森在所有变种中拥有最低的F1,占特定类别F1中总和平方偏差的82.2%;班级排名仍然正常 > CNV > DME > 德鲁森. OCT精度排名与所报告的ImageNet等级不同,B7排名第一. 精确度与参数之比从每百万个总参数的19.82个百分点下降到1.48个百分点。 最终的列车试车间隙与试车精度(r = 0.26,p = 0.53)有微弱的非显著关联. 结论:大型高效网络变体没有一贯改进SD-OCT的分类。 B1实现了最高的精度和Drusen F1,而B7则在更大的模型大小和CPU的空闲度上表现出二级精度回收,表明任务和协议依赖的缩放效果. 由于交叉分部重复未进行独立审计,结果取决于所提供的分部。

articles.title: DreamRealm: Exploring and Materializing Hallucination Worlds for Trustworthy Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain prone to visual hallucinations when correct responses depend on subtle visual details. One line of post-training methods constructs visual contrasts through image retrieval, generation, or editing to improve fine-grained perception. However, these contrasts are not built around the model's own hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions. Another line suppresses hallucinated outputs through response correction or preference learning under fixed image conditions, but leaves the design of supervision signals on the image-input side underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, we introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that explores diverse latent hallucinated responses, minimally edits original images to make them valid, and trains the model to assign each response to its supporting image. Our data construction pipeline, RealmForgePipe, mines observed and latent hallucinations from a target model and materializes them through image editing. Using hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B, we construct the Realized Hallucination Dataset (RealmSet). Our training objective, RealmMatch, constructs a likelihood score matrix across image--response combinations and combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive losses to reinforce correct matches and suppress mismatches. Compared with the original Qwen3.5-9B model, DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. Together with ablation studies on data construction and training methods, these results demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations.

articles.title_zh: DreamRealm:可信赖的视觉-语言模型世界的探索和物质化
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)仍然容易出现视觉幻觉,因为正确的反应取决于微妙的视觉细节. 一行的训练后方法通过图像检索,生成,或编辑构建视觉对比,以改善精细的感知. 然而,这些对比并不是围绕模型本身的幻觉构建的,因此很难确保监督针对其实际的知觉混淆. 另一行通过响应校正或者在固定图像条件下的偏好学习来抑制幻觉输出,但将监督信号的设计留在图像输入方上未得到充分探索. 受人类如何纠正误解的启发,我们引入了DreamRealm,一个后训练框架,探索各种潜在的幻觉反应,尽量减少原始图像的编辑,使其有效,并训练模型将每个反应分配到其辅助图像. 我们的数据建设管道RealmForgePipe、地雷和从目标模型中观察到的潜在幻觉通过图像编辑实现。 利用从Quen3.5-9B中挖掘出来的幻觉,我们构建了已实现的幻觉数据集(RealmSet)。 我们的训练目标RealmMatch构建了一个跨图像-应答组合的概率分数矩阵,并将有监督的学习与双向对比性损失结合起来,强化对匹配的正确性和抑制不匹配. 与最初的Quen3.5-9B模型相比,DreamRealm在6个视觉感知和幻觉基准上提高了性能,包括Hallusion Bench精度的7.26个百分点和MMVP对精度的11.34个百分点. 这些结果连同关于数据构建和培训方法的研究表明,幻觉分配是改善视觉感知和减轻幻觉的有希望的范例。

articles.title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
articles.content: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.

articles.title_zh: 《LLM社会代理人丰富背景和有选择的活力框架》
articles.content_zh: 研究人员在社会模拟中使用大型语言模型作为代理,其中代理者受到旨在塑造其行动的观察和背景资料的激励. 然而,LLM剂已被证明在意义保留下的快速变异下大幅改变他们的行为,为社会模拟造成了验证问题. 一种合理的假设是,这种不易反映缺乏基础,可以通过丰富提供给代理人的背景来减少。 较丰富的环境是否改善了稳健性,这一点仍然不清楚,部分原因是环境的丰富性和稳健性很少被定义为支持有控制的比较。 我们首先需要控制环境的丰富,即一套能够系统地丰富不同类型环境的迅速替代规则:中性铺垫、一般社会背景、描述性决策基础和规范决策基础。 我们通过采用选择性强健性作为验证标准来处理第二个问题:对保留含义的迅速变化不敏感,再加上对社会世界中与决策相关的变化作出方向性反应。 我们在类似囚犯的“困境”游戏中演示这个框架,说明如何利用这个框架来确定哪些形式的上下文丰富产生更可取和更强有力的代理行为。 我们发现,这些浓缩形式产生了不同的行为模式,在所测试的两个模型之间有所不同.

articles.title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
articles.content: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.

articles.title_zh: Spec Compact: 加速 LLM 代理上下文压缩与 Slot-Parallel 语义光谱验证
articles.content_zh: LLM代理使用上下文收缩来管理不断增长的相互作用历史,但用大模型来总结漫长的历史可能会带来大量延误. 因此,压缩需要平衡信息保留与延迟。 我们注意到,结构化的汇总槽在独立生成时可以保留信息. 基于这一观察,我们提出SpecCompact,这个框架通过槽平行语义推测来加速收缩. SpecCompact对一个小的起草器进行微调,并生成平行的槽. 目标模型验证每条拟议线和拒绝的修复内容,而随后的起草则使用更新的槽前缀. 系统优化进一步减少了重复的上下文处理和模型调用. 在整个AppWorld和3美元的基准有两个目标模型,SpecCompact实现2.04美元-5.63美元/次收缩速度超过Hermes风格的汇总。 单独的下游评价揭示了取决于模式和任务的业绩权衡。 赫耳墨斯内部的用户研究进一步显示,中位收缩速度为8.68\times$.

articles.title: Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings
articles.content: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above $m=16$; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.

articles.title_zh: 平衡等级代表性和量化: 文本嵌入中的性能权衡
articles.content_zh: 分级文本嵌入模型提供了可变长的表示,而量化则降低了数值精度;两者都旨在提高计算效率. 这项工作是对这两种已确立的正统技术如何相互作用的经验性基准研究。 我们用四个基于变压器的嵌入模型来评价来自Massive Text Embedding Basic(MTEB)的38项任务,涵盖1D和2D的分级表示,结合32位,8位,和二进制量化,每个任务168个配置. 我们分别报告每个效率方面:理论/每个媒介存储和端到端评价时间。 根据与Nemenyi hoc后分析的Friedman测试,在统计学上,Int8的量化与对等分类和重排的flom32是无法区分的,其成本总体最高为1.5个百分点,而二进制的量化则在每一个任务类别中都严重恶化。 从统计学上看,将嵌入维度减半一次无法检测到高于16,000美元;连续两次将嵌入维度减半总是如此。 将8x维度减小与整数8相结合后,每个载体储存量将减少32x,达到基准效力的94.4%。 由于评估时间被测量过一次,我们把它们视为指示性的:我们没有发现量化能加速评估的证据,而中间层的取样则大大缩短了评估。 检索的降解速度远快于其他类别,因此我们报告每个任务类别的调查结果。

articles.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
articles.content: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: https://long-banana.com/.

articles.title_zh: LongBanana:长文多参考图像综合专家验证基准
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍了Long Banana, 据我们所知,这是在代理驱动图像生成时代,第一个由专家设计并经过专家验证的长文多参考图像合成基准。 这项任务需要检索分散的视觉证据,拒绝分散注意力者,约束实体和关系,并从多个参考物中编织一个连贯的最终图像. Long Banana包含由3乘3分类法精心设计的90项任务;每项任务包括大约32个参考图像,20个限制,以及50个评价项目,总共产生4,670个专家指定的原子评价项目. 其以图表为基础的评价设计将每个任务与参考图像和实体关系图一起进行即时分析,然后将节点、边缘和全图义务转换成内容Fidelity、关系约束和全球约束满意度清单项目。 经审查的专家标签包括一个15%的双标签子集,准确协议为89.4%和0.83四方加权卡帕. 我们进一步引入了长视图像生成的代理harness框架LongBanana-Gen;实验显示,最小的代理电源比直接电源改进,而ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect(RPR)工作流程通过加强证据地面和修复而产生依赖电源的收益。 LongBanana公司共同提供了一个可审计的测试台,用于测量密集的视觉证据使用情况,以及开发更强大的代理驱动图像生成系统的共同目标。 项目网页上有代码和数据:https://long-banana.com/。

articles.title: Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
articles.content: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 人物视角:采用视图点重组法学硕士课程的代表
articles.content_zh: 在大型语言模型(LLMs)中,例如线性探测器和稀疏的自动编码器(SAEs)中,监测特征的常用方法假设特征在各种上下文中保持一致的表示. 然而,LLMS可以灵活地采用不同的观点或"人",暗示概念关系的不同基础体系. 在本文中,我们研究了促使LLM采用一个人物a是否改变了模型潜在空间的表示几何. 我们从采用自由主义和保守主义政治人物的模型中提取9 000多个通用词语和33个语义轴,并与两个中立基线进行比较。 我们认为,人性化条件系统地改变了对语义轴的预测以及轴心之间与特定意识形态一致的方向。 然后,我们检验这次重组对两个与安全有关的特征的影响:真实性和道德。 线性探测器、基于SAE的分类器和由人工选择的单词表达法构建的分类器,都未经人称培训,在适用于以政治人称为条件的模型时产生不同的结果,在有争议的言论上产生政治上偏向真实和道德的评级。 这些调查结果表明,内部表述,如按惯例提取的,在模型采用人时,可能显示不同的几何关系,从而可能破坏监测工作。

articles.title: Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在您继续前: 在对话助理中评价时间敏感安全意识
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)助理越来越多地帮助用户开展日常活动,这些活动涉及时间上的限制。 然而,用户在以后的要求中可能没有提到这些限制,要求助理们承认并相应调整其建议。 为了评估这种能力,我们引入了TASC(对话中的时空行动安全)这一基准,用以评价LLMS在回应对话请求时是否应用了时间上依赖的限制. TASC包含来自128个模板的3,418个输入,还有一套单独的33个设想方案,旨在比较模型计算过期时间的能力与应用这些信息的能力。 在所有13种模式中,助理在拟议行动违反规则的案件中只占30.5%,而很少不必要地警告用户。 更重要的是,模型未能在62.1%的案例中适用这些限制,尽管正确计算了过去的时间。 明确提供时间只能解决其中约一半的失误,揭示出时间推理与其在对话建议中的应用之间的差距.

articles.title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
articles.content: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LooM: Causal Encoder-Decoder 语言模型的循环-内存
articles.content_zh: 循环变换器通过重新激活共享层来增加有效深度,但有三种限制阻碍其采用:内存随循环计数而增长,计算只能以整块步骤调整,循环计数在训练后难以改变. 我们提议LooM(英语:Loop-invariant Memory),它依次讨论每个问题. 在因果编码器-解码器(CED)中,LooM环绕仅是首个之后的解码器层,每个符符读一次一个全局内存,每个符符只在其第一次访问时发布一个符符的密钥值(KV)条目,所以缓存不会随环数增长. 这些层层循环是独立的,每个符号提供从3到21层的每层处决预算,一个随机抽样预算的模型经过培训,在没有路由器的情况下覆盖所有的预算. 有了足够的环路,LooM就超越了在语言建模,零射精度和长康文字复杂度等相同数据上训练的单路基准,同时使用相同的缓存大小. 我们的分析进一步表明,培训预算的分配决定了额外深度的购买力。 这些结果表明,CED是循环的自然地点:内存写一次,深度成为部署时选择的预算.

articles.title: SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
articles.content: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.

articles.title_zh: SAUCE:利用对话进行简要分析
articles.content_zh: 随着对大语言模型及其语音应用的评价需求日益增长,在总结和评价缺乏明确最终目标的对话方面仍然存在挑战。 我们介绍SAUCE -- -- 一个无参考、基于事实的评估程序,用于跨语言对话的演讲总结。 它通过对话与文本之间的必然关系,衡量摘要的准确性和事实覆盖面。 我们比较了SCUCE与几个流行的总结计量标准,并展示了记录因抄录和翻译错误而导致的信息损失以及识别断裂摘要的有效性. 关键是,与黑箱LLM评价器或密集嵌入度量衡不同,SAUCE本质上是可以解释的:它将汇总分数映射到离散的,可核实的事实,允许用户精确地确定准确的幻觉或遗漏. 我们说明这种可解释性如何帮助开发者系统地剖析LLM行为,并给予最终用户一个可操作的工具,以验证在吵闹的现实世界条件下的简要准确性. 初步调查显示SAUCE与人类判断非常一致.

articles.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
articles.content: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.

articles.title_zh: LLMS 不知道他们知道什么:为金融反测试确定时间自我认识的基准
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的财务反证只有在模型已经不知道它被要求预测的结果时才有意义. 从业人员通过信任一个供应商申报的知识截断、询问该模型知道什么或指示该模型在过去某个日期作出答复来防范这种情况。 为了核实这些保障措施是否可信,我们采用了FinDendro,这是1999年至2026年美国事实的2 226个基准,涵盖每月宏观经济系列、月终股票价格和美联储的决定。 每个事实都产生四个因素:价值问题、将每个候选人的价值与声称知道或猜测没有宣布的日期联系起来的回顾和预测问题,以及将预测性问题与历史宣布的日期联系起来的问题。 对持久性和主要结果的控制使概率精确度接近0.27。 结果表明,对于大多数前沿模型,自我报告低估了知识。 GPT-5正确回答76%的控制事实,但声称知道38%,回答61%说不知道的事实. 知识主张可以持续超过所计量的知识界限,最长可达7/4,一个宣布的日期可以消除以前知识主张的大部分,同时保持准确性不变. 因此,模型培训窗口内的反测试不能通过自我报告、指示或说明的截断来证明无漏。 这些发现激励了对时空知识边界的行为测量,FinDendro提供了基于已证实的事实知识选择回溯测试期的基准和程序.

articles.title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
articles.content: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.

articles.title_zh: 衡量风险,而不是伤害:检测心理 LLM 对话中的危害风险因素
articles.content_zh: 与大语言模型互动产生的心理伤害无法直接监测,因为它们可能从反复互动中产生,并严重依赖主观个体用户背景. 我们建议衡量风险,而不是伤害:在AI反应层面检测构成心理伤害风险因素的可见AI行为,并汇总这些信号以支持纵向监测. 我们操作了八种这种行为,并构建了47,062人工智能回复和373,873个响应因子标签的合成多标签体,并附有有针对性的人类说明以供验证和评价。 然后我们比较训练有素的嵌入式分类器,直接进行LLM判断,以及进行分类式判断的级联. 所有探测器都具有模型不可知性,只使用LLM输出,不需要进入内部模型状态. 我们把这些探测器应用到 之前研究的几套分散式 人类-AI对话数据集中 根据被搁置的人类标记数据,最好的级联的宏观精确度为0.86,回顾0.76和F1为0.79。 在WildChat上,与直接判断相比,LLM法官的电话减少了97.1+%。 在DelusionEval上,在对话中进行风险因素检测集群. 我们的结果表明,反应层面的行为风险因素检测可为纵向心理-安全监测提供一个可伸缩的测量层,而不会将可观察到的AI行为与潜在的用户伤害混为一谈。

articles.title: Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors
articles.content: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.

articles.title_zh: 在两个发行的纸张接受指数中排位协议不揭示段落编辑协议
articles.content_zh: 一个快速接受分类器可以为速度较慢的评价员选择修改. 我们问,就现有文件达成协议是否支持这种使用。 我们比较了一个单词和文档特性的分类器,与两个发布的仅文本的接受预测器从同一个语言模型中微调了30亿参数. 对于国际学习代表性会议的198篇论文,我们比较了对原始论文和段落进行自动重排的模型排名,以了解未变的事实、主张的力量和归属。 分类者将原始文件与一个预测器进行紧密的排序,与另一个预测器进行中度的排序,但并没有显示任何一种可察觉的协议,因为重写者会提高分数。 预先规定的试验采用了较低的数值精度。 四舍五入的错误在小分数的答复中占主导地位。 因此,我们以32位的精确度将释放的重量重新计分,作为临时检查;编辑协议仍然接近零。 在这种精准度下,当每个预测器在每张纸的5个重写中选择时,其平均原始得分低于比随机选择高100分中的2分. 证据包括一个家庭的列报重写和两个公开预测器;向费用昂贵的评价员的转让仍未经过测试。 因此,应对照预定评价人员对修订工作进行排序检查。

articles.title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
articles.content: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.

articles.title_zh: 用小语言模型模拟 Shell 输出的模板缺口重建
articles.content_zh: 小型语言模型为壳体模拟提供了一个紧凑的基础,而无需执行提交的命令,但全输出代码要求它们与不同执行的内容一起预测经常性的效用结构. 我们采用了模板差距重建(TGR),它提供可重复使用的产出文字,与哨兵相交,与自动产生的差距相交。 模板选择器选择要重建的模板,空模板保留全输出代码. 我们从不同执行环境收集的1 870万项产出中建造一个模板库,并培训一个模板选择器和五个重建模型,这些模型是从各种小语言模式检查站启动的,其目标环境被排除在银行建筑之外。 评价表明,当最佳模板涵盖模板的25+%以上时,TGR会改进产出编辑的相似性(O-ES),而不是全产出代码(FOD),同时对覆盖度较低的产出进行类似的处理。 此外,TGR在较短的空隙序列方面优于FOD,O-ES值分别为0.964和0.812,同时保持较长序列的类似性能. TGR减少26.3-38.3XXX在常用的代币家庭产生的代币数量. 这些结果支持使用可重复使用的产出结构作为小壳模拟器的实用设计选择,提高响应忠心度并缩短生成目标,同时将模板选择和剩余预测保持在响应质量的核心.

articles.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
articles.content: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.

articles.title_zh: Turns matter: 通过 Turn- Level 信用来推进视频 RL
articles.content_zh: 流畅的视频理解需要模型反复决定是回应还是继续观测. 最近,集团相对政策优化(GRPO)被应用于这一环境,现有做法强调奖励设计,同时保留单一的轨迹水平优势。 这种共享的信用可以强化先前成功之后的多余答复,并阻碍先前失败之后的有益后续行动。 我们提议TurnWise,这是一个使学习与个别流化决定相一致的回合级GPRO框架。 TurnWise处理轨迹级反馈和回合级互动之间的不匹配,促进信息化响应,减少冗余. 具体地说,回合级的信用分配使用静态完成的前缀评分来构建与每个决定的剩余回报有关的优势,将其学习信号与早期的奖励区分开来. 转动政策优化平均在每个转动周期内和转动周期内出现象征性损失,无论产出长度如何,给予响应和等待决定同等权重. 这些互补设计改进了无学问批评者或额外推出的流派政策学习。 广泛的实验显示,我们的方法在流传视频理解方面超过了以往的RL方法。

articles.title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 多种语言课程中非参数内存的原因:基于认知的关联知识分析
articles.content_zh: 检索增强的生成(RAG)假设语言模型可以解释其上下文所述的关系,而不是回到在预训期间被记住的协会。 我们孤立地研究这种以证据为条件的关系推理,直接提供事实,而不是直接取回。 \textsc{Rel-Bloom}是一种从30 Wikidata关系建立起来的450个多选择问题的受控多语言诊断;同样的源关系在五个Bloom启发级别(记住,理解,应用,分析,评价)和三个真实条件下(事实,反事实,中立)被即时化. 在43个模型、6种语言和2个多语种环境(226 800个预测)中,有3个结论突出。 首先,在每个评估的开放重量模型系列中,精度从应用到分析急剧下降,大花岗岩桶的精度达到47.2个百分点,但双子座模型均没有达到47.2个百分点. 第二,我们... 即便对其他任务类型接近上限的模型而言,评价项目仍是一个瓶颈:双子座~3.1 其他四个级别平均有99.5×××, 而评价为60.7×××。 第三,各语文之间始终保留项目和关系级难度排名,表明在本基准内各语文之间部分共享的困难结构。 在整个知识条件下,反事实环境一般比事实环境更困难,而去除实体身份可以提高一些模型制度中的更高水平的性能. 因此,增强模型能力本身并不能确保就所提供的关系证据进行可靠的推理。 有关资源可在以下网址查阅:https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/n-parameroy-memory-relation-reasoning。

articles.title: ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
articles.content: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.

articles.title_zh: ALTO: 非洲和黎凡丁技术促进性别暴力公司
articles.content_zh: 技术推动的性别暴力是一种普遍存在的在线伤害,通过许多直接和隐蔽的形式影响妇女和性别少数群体。 目前用于检测性别危害的模型和附加说明的数据集以来自全球北方语言的数据和培训的模型为主。 我们与来自约旦、西非法语国家和肯尼亚的民间社会组织合作,制订了一种由社区牵头的办法,以利万丁语、非洲法语和斯瓦希里语将过渡联邦政府的文化和语言相关案例集中起来。 我们用积极学习来开发一个名为ALTO的小型但能发挥效能的数据集(N=3022)来说明众包数据,以改善对三种语言的TRABBV的检测。 通过制定基准和微调试验,我们显示,现有的有害内容检测模型显示,ALTO内部的TRABV召回情况不佳,并经过微调而改进。 我们发现模型经常错过所有语言的隐蔽伤害,而斯瓦希里语的误差率明显较高. 我们报告实验结果 发布注释分类学 数据集 和训练有素的模型

articles.title: Beyond accuracy: what AI assurance needs to establish in public services
articles.content: Public bodies increasingly rely on AI-produced evidence, including classifications, summaries and assessments. These outputs can inform policy decisions and service delivery, making their reliability a matter of public accountability. Establishing whether this evidence can be relied upon requires testing its outputs and examining how organisations decide whether those tests are sufficient. We combine technical evaluation with analysis of AI governance requirements, informed by measurement theory and management-based regulation. We compare eight GPT-4o configurations classifying 1,200 UK Prime Minister's Questions into 21 policy topics, against human-coded labels and across unchanged repeats. Accuracy ranges from 68.2% to 70.3%, yet 24.3% of questions receive different labels, with changes in topic shares and rankings. Configurations agree more with one another than with human coding: agreement does not guarantee correctness. Under the implemented score-extraction procedure, the proportion flagged for human review ranges from 0.9% to 41.0%. We analyse 37 UK and EU policy documents. Both sets expect testing and oversight, but reporting expectations do not consistently cover changing answers, shared errors, selective evaluation, substantive conclusions or review routing. Some UK guidance explicitly addresses stability. The UK sample emphasises public bodies checking their own use; the EU places substantial testing duties on providers while leaving them important choices about measures and acceptance thresholds. Without appropriate checks, evidence could misrepresent policy issues, redirect attention or resources, and leave errors undetected. Public policy should require organisations to justify reliance through checks beyond aggregate accuracy, clear responsibility, access to expertise and scrutiny of results.

articles.title_zh: 超出准确性:大赦国际的保证需要在公共服务中确立什么
articles.content_zh: 公共机构越来越依赖大赦国际提供的证据,包括分类、摘要和评估。 这些产出可以为政策决定和提供服务提供信息,使其可靠性成为公共问责问题。 要确定是否可以依赖这些证据,就必须测试其产出,并审查各组织如何决定这些测试是否充分。 我们把技术评估与AI治理要求的分析结合起来,以衡量理论和管理监管为基础。 我们比较了8个GPT-4o配置,将1,200个英国首相问题分为21个政策主题,对照人码标签和没有改变的重复。 准确率从68.2%到70.3%不等,然而24.3%的提问收到不同的标签,话题份额和排名都有变化. 配置相互之间比人类编码更一致:协议不能保证正确性. 根据已执行的分数提取程序,标注给人审查的比例从0.9%到41.0%不等。 我们分析了37份联合王国和欧盟政策文件。 这两套系统都期望进行测试和监督,但报告预期并不始终涵盖不断变化的答案、共同错误、选择性评价、实质性结论或审查路径。 联合王国的一些指导明确涉及稳定问题。 联合王国的样本强调公共机构检查自己的用途;欧盟对供应商规定了大量的测试义务,同时让他们对措施和接受阈值作出重要选择。 没有适当的检查,证据可能歪曲政策问题,转移注意力或资源,使错误不被察觉。 公共政策应当要求各组织通过超出总体准确性、明确责任、获得专门知识和对结果进行审查的检查来证明依赖的合理性。

articles.title: Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
articles.content: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.

articles.title_zh: 用大语言模型进行政治和社会科学研究的可复制性、可复制性和强性
articles.content_zh: 本章论述大语言模型研究的中心再生产问题. LLM输出是概率性的,各模型和版本不同,可对下游统计结果产生重大影响. 本章区分了可复制性,可复制性,稳健性,并提出了基于结果分配的概率标准,而不是相同的产出. 它引入了标准化的即时脚本,测试编码器和解码器的模型内变异,并开发出错误结构分析,以判断模型哪里出错以及其错误是否一致. 本章使用三个数据集,表明测量选择可以逆转下游回归系数的标志. 现有的以设计为基础的带有金色标记的子样本的校正恢复了有效性,但以估计精度为代价。 该章的主要贡献是叠装的开量模型组合,在保持估计有效性的同时提高校正步骤的精度.

articles.title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
articles.content: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

articles.title_zh: 总结何时成为指示? LLM 代理自写手势摘要中不支持的政策
articles.content_zh: 长期运行的LLM代理压缩了他们的上下文,以摘要取代大多数历史. 我们询问,交接摘要是否说明记录不支持授权或要求,这些句子是否改变下个案例(继承者)的工作,以及它们来自何处。 合成工具- 使用任务带有一个地面真实权限分类账; 同一 snapshot 重播后继者, 并用中性填充器取代整个句子 。 两位AI阅读者只阅读标有规则的搁置摘要,证实两个开放量级模型所有可读摘要的1.2%和2.4%有不支持的限制,以及0.1%和1.3%。 对于限制,预设的重播测试并不显著(p=0.58);后续计划之后,后续发现脆弱效应(p=0.027). 消除虚假的核准行为将未经授权的行动从120次搁置(事后临时安排;后期安排:48次搁置中的17次削减至11次)中的24次削减至7次。 大多数发展限制都遵循了代理人早先的推理,即一项行动需要批准(事后临时). 在预先指定的测试中,将系统提示的“某些行动需要批准”替换为“要求从不支持的开发摘要的5.0%削减到1.8%,在搁置的模板中,要求从1.8%削减到0.3%(这两页都 < 10^-9),而要求批准分类账的要求几乎没有改变。 代码和数据:https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

articles.title: Dialect Matters: A Dialect-Aware Baseline for Igala-English Machine Translation
articles.content: The massive permeability of intelligent systems in every sphere of human activities have greatly enhanced clarity, ease of work, and increased general global understanding which has significantly awaken the use of intelligent systems by all users. Intelligent systems greatly rely on precise dataset/corpus for the correctness of their output. Despite efforts by researchers to address Low-resource language in the Natural Language Processing (NLP), Igala still has zero parallel corpora despite efforts by researchers. We present a dialect-aware baseline for Igala-English machine translation, among first open systems and first with dialectal variation analysis. Our dataset of 1137 sentences (899 training) is first with dialect tags: Idah 459 (40.4%), Ankpa 297 (26.1%), Ibaji 160 (14.1%), Other 187 (16.4%), Ogugu 32 (2.8%). Same English yields 20-60 Igala forms. Mixed-dialect training achieves balanced BLEU 11.66 versus Idah-only model which drops 4.7 BLEU on Ibaji (13.2 on Idah, 8.5 on Ibaji), proving dialect fairness requires mixing. Fine-tuned from Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul (78M), epoch ablation shows convergence at 8 epochs and overfitting at 15. BLEU 11.66, chrF 46.69. Analysis shows 899 sentences on log-linear trend consistent with African low-resource literature. This work provides first dialectal impact analysis for Igala and establishes baseline for future work.

articles.title_zh: Dialect matters: Igala-英文机器翻译的 Dialect-Aware 基线
articles.content_zh: 智能系统在人类活动的每一个领域都具有巨大的渗透性,大大提高了清晰度和工作的便利性,提高了全球普遍的认识,大大唤醒了所有用户对智能系统的使用。 智能系统在输出的正确性上在很大程度上依赖于精确的数据集/公司. 尽管研究人员努力解决自然语言处理(NLP)中的低资源语言问题,但尽管研究人员作出了努力,伊加拉仍然拥有零平行的蝎子. 我们提出了Igala-英语机器翻译的方言认识基线,在第一个开放系统中,首先进行方言变化分析。 我们的1137句(899个训练)的数据集首先有方言标记:Idah 459(40.4%),Ankpa 297(26.1%),Ibaji 160(14.1%),其他187(16.4%),Ogugu 32(2.8%). 同样的英语产量为20-60 Igala形式. 混合射线培训实现平衡的BLEU 11.66比 证明方言公平需要混合。 由赫尔辛基-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul(78M)进行精细校正,划时代的弯曲显示在8个纪元时趋同,15岁时的弯曲过度. BLEU 11.66, chrF 46.69 (英语). 分析显示,与非洲低资源文献一致的对数线趋势有899句. 这项工作为伊加拉提供了第一次方言影响分析,并为今后的工作确定了基线。

articles.title: NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria
articles.content: Multilingual benchmarks for African languages mostly translate generic questions into local languages, measuring linguistic competence but not whether models know facts about Africa. We introduce \naija, a benchmark of factual and statistical questions about Nigeria, authored by native speakers and grounded in authoritative official statistics, with every question available in English, Nigerian Pidgin, \yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa. Answering similar questions for the UK and US yields a country by language matrix that disentangles a language effect (the model knows the fact but degrades in a low-resource language) from a knowledge effect (the fact is absent in every language). Across eight frontier and Nigeria-adapted models, the knowledge effect dominates: English-query accuracy is 49--50\% for the US/UK but 20\% for Nigeria. The language effect is smaller and tracks web representation, degrading from English to \yoruba{} (9 points on Nigeria, up to 24 on US/UK questions). We find scale does not help: the strongest models reach 66--79\% on the UK and the US but none exceed 31\% on Nigerian statistics. Extending to all 54 African countries with our best performing frontier model shows the same profile continent-wide, 96\% on culture and 98\% on politics against 26\% on statistics, so the gap is not specific to Nigeria.

articles.title: CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
articles.content: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.

articles.title_zh: CRESiST:自强探索性政策学习,同时翻译演讲
articles.content_zh: 同时进行语音翻译(SimulST)需要平衡翻译质量和时间。 虽然大语言模型(LLMs)在离线翻译方面表现优异,但目前基于LLM的SimulST系统主要依赖于前缀增量生成. 这个范式存在冗余的密钥-Value缓存重算问题,需要外部语音活动检测来处理未绑定的流. 为了克服这些瓶颈,我们提议在全方位LLM的基础上建立一个端到端的互页读写框架。 通过切换语音块和文本符号,我们的架构实现了完整的 KV 缓存再利用, 本土支持无分割,无限长的推论. 此外,为了学习最佳的流线政策,而不僵硬的离线调整,我们引入了一个新的演员-批评自我增强管道。 一个RNN-T演员动态采样读写轨迹,而基于LLM的批评者通过内在的语义和时间性奖励来评价这些路径,将最佳政策提炼回演员. 关于句子一级(FLEURS, CoVoST2)和文件一级(MuST-C, ACL 60/60)基准的广泛实验表明,我们的模式建立了新的最先进的质量不老的帕雷托边界线,大大超过了现有的级联和静态调整基线。

articles.title: LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering
articles.content: Most speech large language models (SLMs) still process speech in an offline manner. They only start responding after they receive the complete speech segment. However, many real-world applications require streaming speech interaction, for which the audio continuously flows in and the machine is required to answer questions based on the so far received audio chunks. For example, a user may ask the system to continuously count how many times a person's name has been mentioned while they are speaking. We observe a lack of benchmarks and evaluation protocols for real-time speech interaction. Motivated by this, we propose LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a dataset and a benchmark for real-time speech interaction. We construct different types of real-time question-answer pairs from LibriSpeech to evaluate whether speech LLMs can identify target words in streaming audio. We evaluate several popular real-time commercial models and find that they still tend to respond only after the speech turn has finished. We demonstrate that we can enable a pretrained SLM to perform this task, where we explore several modeling designs and establish a solid baseline for future research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LibriSpeech-Real-QA:简化问题回答基准
articles.content_zh: 大多数语音大语言模型(SLMS)仍然以离线方式处理语音. 他们只有在收到完整的演讲部分后才开始回应. 然而,许多现实世界的应用需要流体语音交互,为此音频持续流进,机器需要根据迄今为止收到的音频块回答问题. 例如,一个用户可能会要求系统在说话时不断计算一个人的名字被提及的次数. 我们注意到缺乏实时语音互动的基准和评价协议。 为此,我们提议LibriSpeech-Real-QA,一个数据集和一个实时语音互动的基准. 我们从 LibriSpeech 构造了不同类型的实时问答对,以评估语音 LLMS 能否识别流音中的目标单词. 我们评价了几个流行的实时商业模型,发现它们仍然倾向于只在演讲回合结束后才作出反应. 我们表明,我们能够使经过预先培训的可持续土地管理能够完成这项任务,在那里,我们探索若干模型设计,并为今后的研究确定坚实的基线。

articles.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
articles.content: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

articles.title_zh: 在LLM代理中,多窗强化学习真正有什么改进?
articles.content_zh: 虽然多回合促进强化学习(RL)在长期任务上表现优异,但其业绩的提高仍然对互动制约高度敏感。 在通过美元Pass@(K,T)美元进行抽样广度和互动深度评估时,我们显示轨迹水平的RL优势取决于充足的转折预算,在预算紧缩时大幅降低。 此外,代理RL并没有统一提升单步骤决策质量;相反,其强度集中在错误回收和长视距抗御能力上。 为了减轻这种预算依赖性造成的部署风险,我们初步讨论了流程监督信号的好处和局限性,并引入了预算混合资源,作为培训期间互动预算的替代办法。 实验表明,预算混合RL在不同的执行环境中取得了强劲的业绩. 项目网页:https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

articles.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
articles.content: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ArcRAG:对知识图的代理结构检索
articles.content_zh: 基于图形的检索增强生成(GraphRAG)通过对从一个实体中构建的知识图进行检索来回答问题. 然而,回收战略是围绕着它们自己生产的建筑管道的结构设计的,它们是否在建筑改变后幸存下来很少经过测试。 我们研究了这种跨构造的可移植性:当图形的构建不同时,一个没有特定构造方案、关系名称或重新调整的检索程序是否仍然有效。 我们引入了ArcRAG,它诱导了一个在推论时间的查询-局部图界面(节点标签,关系描述符,以及实体可以到达的属性密钥一个问号),计划了多跳转对它,并作为Cypher执行和修复. 我们把MusiQue,HotpotQA,TriviaQA corpora 的每个图建成一个以图示为指南的图集(型号为节点,闭合关系集,源代码为源代码),并作为开放信息采集图集(非型号为节点,自由文本关系),其间固定了检索器的配置. 我们比较了一种构造不可知的直线-线圈剂,通过两个图系的重试和通过预算来降低每个阶段,并与以往的GraphRAG系统报告的结果进行比较,这些系统大多是设计检索和自己的图构造。 在整个两个构造中,我们发现检索不需要与图表共同设计:查询-时间界面感应在构造改变时保持一个构造-不可知的检索器有效,尽管构造仍然塑造绝对的准确性.

articles.title: EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution
articles.content: Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EvoGuard: 减轻在线技能演变中的退化
articles.content_zh: 技能使语言代理人能够重新利用各种任务的经验作为自然语言文件。 最近的工作从互动中演化出技能,但当技能在线演化时,现有方法有局限性. 先前的方法从通过许多任务收集的一批轨迹上更新了一种离线技能. 有些人然后在没有检查的情况下采用新技能,这可能会随着时间的推移而降低技能。 其他人只保留它,只要它在被搁置的验证套件上改进性能,每次更新后运行速度太慢,成本太高. 我们引入了EvoGuard,一种双向技能选择器,以低延迟和低成本缓解技能退化. 我们首先迭代运行代理 建立技能的集合 在每个技能在私人测试集中得分 以获得公用事业标签。 我们把技能配对,使用拒绝抽样,只保留有明显效用差距的对子. 选择者在两个标签符号的日志上接受训练,以选择更好的技能. 在部署时,它决定采用单一的前进通道,这大大快于对私人测试集的评价。 与采用每种新技能相比,EvoGuard在ALFWorld上提高了11.0%,在ScienceWorld上提高了5.9%,在LiveCode Bench上提高了2.7%.
